messages:
Maria L: Async sync: FieldOps POC — scope + cutover. Start here. EOW = Friday. Primary ask: SE to deliver integration artifacts (schema, sample payloads, webhook contract) by Thu COB. Dev freeze Tue 09:00 PT. Ping owners below.

Priya S: Confirmed. I'll own integration artifacts. ETA Thu noon PST. Question: do you want API-key auth or mTLS for webhook callbacks?

Jordan (Eng PM): API-key is fine for initial trial; security requested mTLS for Prod only. Document preference in runbook. Also who will provision staging VLAN/whitelist?

Leo (Sales): I can chase FieldOps infra — they said they'll do whitelist but need IP list and port numbers. @Ava can you paste current staging egress IPs?

Ava (DevEng): Staging egress: 34.82.11.9, 34.82.11.10. Ports 443/8443. Will put ips in Confluence page: https://confluence.redwood.com/fieldops/staging-network

Maria L: Thanks. Deliverables checklist (quick):
- SE: schema + sample payloads + auth method (Priya)
- Eng: API freeze Tue 09:00 PT (Ava)
- Infra: whitelist & staging readiness by Wed EOD (Leo/FieldOps)
- QA: smoke test plan + success criteria (Jordan)
Success criteria: 95% accuracy for rulings, <300ms median latency for 512 tokens, stable webhook retries.

Priya S: Got it. Adding sample payload examples in repo: https://repo.redwood.com/fieldops-poc/examples. Also adding failback: webhook retries + idempotency key.

Jordan (Eng PM): Adding QA owner @Nina to draft smoke tests. Nina, can you cover basic throughput test + webhook retry logic?

Nina (QA): On it. Will have smoke test steps + k6 script by Thu morning.

Leo (Sales): :thumbsup: I'll confirm FieldOps contact list and schedule the cutover call Fri 09:30 PT if staging looks good.

Ava (DevEng): Heads up — there is one breaking API change in branch feature/fast-headers that I'm going to revert to meet freeze; will open PR now and request review @Maria L @Jordan

Maria L: Please add changelog line in PR and tag #release-prep. We'll do code review asap. If review blocks, fallback to canary deploy.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Staging deploy triggered for commit abc123. ETA ~10m. Logs: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/1234

Leo (Sales): Noted. If any blocker, call me. FieldOps has a hard deadline next Tue.

Priya S: Question: for success criteria, do we include end-to-end latency from FieldOps UI? They want 150-200ms but we only control backend.

Jordan (Eng PM): Capture both backend and E2E. We'll mark 300ms backend SLA and note typical frontend overhead. Document in runbook.

Maria L: Perfect. Next steps — Priya posts artifacts by Thu noon; Nina posts smoke tests Thu morning; infra confirms whitelist Wed EOD; eng freeze Tue 09:00. If all green we go Fri cutover call. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
